In 0.6.1 its kind moved from re-test to change, typed remove (#64): in the 2026-09-29 capability evaluation a held-out answer key required removing `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0`, every skill run kept it as a re-test by following this trap, and only the plain session with the doc links proposed the edit. The model-config page states outright that the setting has no effect on Sonnet 5.5, so nothing is left to re-test. The setting stays as already decided where the project records that it still serves another model, a Sonnet 5 fallback or an agent pinned to a model where it still turns thinking off, which the page's own exception list supports.

Written in 0.5.0 for the Sonnet 5 → 5.5 audit from the Sonnet 5.5 prompting guide, migration guide and Claude Code documentation (#28). Its areas became ids of the plan's map in #61 (hooks → hooks, settings), after a graded run missed a planted P13 in a skill that the trap's area did not cover. In 0.6.1 its kind moved from re-test to change for a per-call countdown or budget, which is removed or made rare (#64): in the 2026-09-29 capability evaluation a held-out answer key required that edit for a hook adding a per-tool-call budget countdown, and every skill run kept it as a re-test. The guide says outright not to add such a countdown in interactive sessions, while for other per-step context it says to send it less often only where the misread shows, so that case stays a re-test. The inference that a hook's context reaches the model right after the tool results became a passage of the hooks page, and the confidence rose from low to medium.

Added in 0.6.1 as a sibling of P27 (#65). In the 2026-09-29 capability evaluation the calibrated harness held a skill that sends a message to a running agent mid-turn, and the traps stage recorded P27 as not checkable, since P27 covers only Claude API code and is a hand-off. The guide names messages that arrive while the model is partway through a multistep turn among the causes of the injection misread, so the risk also sits in instruction text. P27 stays an API hand-off and this trap covers the instruction areas. It is a re-test of low confidence, since the Claude Code docs do not say where a message to a working agent lands relative to its tool results.
